thread:
lucy: Heads-up — release cut blocked. CI verify failed during artifact upload: checksum mismatch. deploy-bot auto-aborted the promote.

ci-bot: [automated] upload: checksum verification failed (expected=sha256:9f8e7d6c got=sha256:9f8e0000). See job 8124: https://ci.internal/8124/logs

ben: Which ref? Can we fallback to last-known-good?

lucy: It was redwood/runner@2026-04-02-rc1. Last-known-good is redwood/runner@2026-03-31-rc9.

ben: Quick triage — runner-42 reported low disk and lots of docker overlay churn yesterday. If the tar couldn't stream fully it would truncate and produce this. infra-oncall, can you check runner-42 disk and agent logs?

infra-oncall: Checking now. Runner-42 shows disk pressure at 02:10UTC and buildkite-agent logs include: "write: short write, wrote 4104320 of 4524192". Also saw HTTP 499 from registry at same time. I'll restart the agent and clear temp dirs.

lucy: Given our change window in 30m I recommend manual pin to rc9 so we don't risk customers. We can re-promote rc1 after we confirm runner stability.

ben: +1 pin. Avoids delaying the window. Please call deploy-bot to pin and add release note.

lucy: /promote redwood/runner@2026-03-31-rc9 --reason "manual pin: rc1 artifact upload truncated on runner-42 (checksum mismatch)"

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Running pre-promotion checks.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete  redwood/runner@2026-03-31-rc9 promoted to candidate. Release notes appended: "Pinned to last-known-good after artifact upload truncation for newer build."

ci-bot: job 8124 (rerun) started on runner-43 (fresh host).

ci-bot: job 8124 (rerun) finished: SUCCESS. Artifact uploaded and verified successfully on rerun.

ben: Rerun succeeded but still good we pinned for the window. infra-oncall please file ISSUE-1100 to investigate runner-42 disk churn and add uploader preflight checksum+retries.

infra-oncall: ISSUE-1100 filed with agent logs and disk usage snapshots. Assigning to infra and release eng. Will monitor runner fleet for similar events.

lucy: Thanks. Action items: infra-oncall - investigate runner-42 and add uploader preflight; ben - coordinate a controlled re-promote after post-release smoke tests; deploy-bot - hold any auto-promote retries for rc1 until we green the hotfix pipeline.

ben: Noted. I'll schedule the re-promote if post-release checks pass.

lucy: Closing for now. Reopen this thread if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
